## Takeaways

- US dominance in semiconductors is more fragile than it appears
- TSMC's location in Taiwan is simultaneously a strategic asset and liability
- Export controls accelerate rival domestic semiconductor programs

## Why read this

Essential background for anyone working on technology geopolitics. Miller traces how semiconductor supply chains became the central nervous system of modern geopolitics.
